title: Bank item evaluation record
description: Curator evaluation of one catalogue/banks item for licence, Bloom level, FAME fitness, and disposition toward practice-designer. Does not replace bank-item.schema.json; complements it.

bloom_level.description: Primary cognitive process target (Waterloo CTE / revised Bloom).

process_tags.description: Process ids aligned with lesson-brief / module bank slots

suitable_as_worked.description: Clear multi-step solution suitable for a worked example

suitable_for_fading.description: Later steps can be removed for partial / guided practice (EEF reverse-order fading)

suitable_for_alternating_pair.description: Has or can pair with a similar I-do / you-do companion before variation

mistakes_example_ok.description: True only if clearly signpostable as incorrect AND intended after competence (EEF Mistakes)

explanation_prompt_suggested.description: Self-explanation / think-aloud prompt id or draft note (how/why a step); null if N/A

licence_ok.description: Licence and permitted_use_status allow intended use

student_html_allowed.description: Must match bank item; false for Nelson density-oracle rows

remember_only_flag.description: True if item only quizzes Remember while brief/module targets Apply+
